rules.name: Advanced Targeting Solutions
rules.description: All Attacks made by this Battle Group at Short Range may re-roll any attempt to cause a Critical Hit.

rules.name: Wall of Fire
rules.description: The Cerberus Battle Group may roll 2x Halo Dice rather than just 1 when attempting to overload an enemy's defences with MACs, prior to a Defensive Dice Pool being rolled.

rules.name: Unique Ability - Lord Hood
rules.description: Lord Hood is unflappable under pressure and measured in all aspects of his command. He can choose to add +1 to the Initiative Dice roll each Turn.

rules.name: Unique Ability - Michael Stanforth
rules.description: Vice Admiral Stanforth galvanised the UNSC forces at Reach into a formidable force using a combination of raw charisma and intuitive command skills. Stanforth may re-roll TWO Fleet Orders Dice once per Turn. The second result MUST be accepted.

rules.name: Automated Repair Systems
rules.description: Each time a Vulnerable Marker is applied to a Section of this Massive Element, roll a Halo Dice: On the result of a "1" or a "2", the Vulnerable Marker is instantly removed.

rules.name: Frigate Resupply
rules.description: During the Repairs Setp of any End Phase, a Punic-class Supercarrier may allow a SINGLE Paris Formation Base within 10" to remove a SINGLE Damage Marker from its base. Where applicable, this action CAN be used to restore Titanium Armour to the Formation Base.

rules.name: Limited Resources
rules.description: All Punic-class Supercarriers exist as individual Battle Groups and are not required to follow the standard rules for Battle Group creation. Whilst they are not Specialist Battle Groups, they are restricted by the sie of the Fleet they are attached to. A single Punic-class Supercarrier can be included in a Fleet for every FULL 1250 Points being played.

rules.name: Pack Hunters
rules.description: All Elements in this Battle Group may re-roll any Initial Rolls of a "SKULL" when firing MACs - these re-rolled dice may NOT generate any further re-rolls.

rules.name: Unique Ability - UNSC Generic Fleet Commander
rules.description: Once per Game Turn, the UNSC Commander may re-roll their bording D6 when Defending against an enemy Boarding Action. The second result must be accepted.

rules.name: Ammunition Re-Supply
rules.description: This Formation ignores all Damage when determining its number of Successes when firing MACs and Missile weapons.

rules.name: Unique Ability - Cortana
rules.description: Cortana is resourceful and cunning, and her survival is a priority for the UNSC. Should the Element containing Cortana be Destroyed, roll a Halo Dice - on a roll of any result other than a "SKULL", Cortana may be placed on a nearby friendly vessel within 12". Should Cortana roll a "SKULL" when trying to escape, or have no friendly Formation Base within 12" however, Cortana is removed from the game and the enemy Fleet gains an additional +4 VPs.

characteristics.name: Effect
characteristics.$text: When targeted by a Firing Solution or when Colliding with Terrain, the total number of attack successes rolled against the nominated target is reduced by -2.

characteristics.name: Use
characteristics.$text: This Order must be issued before any inital Attack Dice Roll.

characteristics.name: Effect
characteristics.$text: An Element may roll a Halo Dice during the Repair Phase. On the Roll of a "1" or "2" the formation may remove a single Damage Marker from its base.

characteristics.name: Use
characteristics.$text: This Order may be issued during the Repairs Step of the End Phase.

characteristics.name: Effect
characteristics.$text: ONCE per Turn, Lord Hood can call a general attack order, allowing up to TWO standard Battle Groups to activate together, performing their respective Movement and Attack Segments as if they were a single Battle Group for the remainder of the Game Turn.

characteristics.name: Use
characteristics.$text: This Order must be issued during the Execute Orders step of the Orders Phase.

characteristics.name: Effect
characteristics.$text: An Element may reroll up to TWO Attack Dice. These dice may only be rerolled once.

characteristics.name: Use
characteristics.$text: This Order is issued after any inital dice are rolled either the attack segment or the boarding resolution phase.

characteristics.name: Effect
characteristics.$text: The Fleet Commander may order the rebuilding of a Battle Group up to a maximum of BR of 6. See the Adhoc Battle Groups rules in the rulebook.

characteristics.name: Use
characteristics.$text: This Order may be issued during the Execute Orders Step of the Order Dice Phase.

characteristics.name: Effect
characteristics.$text: Cortana can hack the command and control network of the enemy Battle Group. For this Turn only, reduce all Attack Firepower Ratings of an enemy Battle Group by -2.

characteristics.name: Use
characteristics.$text: This order must be issued during the Execute Orders Step of the Orders Phase.

characteristics.name: Effect
characteristics.$text: Remove ALL Vunerable Markers from ALL Elements in a selected Battle Group.

characteristics.name: Use
characteristics.$text: This Order must be issued during the Orders Step of the selected Battle Group's Activation.

characteristics.name: Effect
characteristics.$text: Cortana takes control of all missile Targeting in a Battle Group, and removes the stipulation for any Missile Barrage to target the closest enemy when firing in their Fore Arc.

characteristics.name: Use
characteristics.$text: This Order must be issued prior to an enemy target being nominated for an attack by Missile Weapons.

characteristics.name: Effect
characteristics.$text: Increase the security detail present on-board a single friendly Capital Element by +4 for this Turn.

characteristics.name: Use
characteristics.$text: This Order must be issued during the Orders Step of the Boarding Resolution Phase.

characteristics.name: Effect
characteristics.$text: Increase the Attack Dice of EACH friendly Security Detail on-board a target enemy element by +2.

characteristics.name: Use
characteristics.$text: This Order must be issued during the Orders Step of the Boarding Resolution Phase.

characteristics.name: Effect
characteristics.$text: Increase the Firepower Rating of a Defensive Roll made by a Capital Ship by +1 this turn.

characteristics.name: Use
characteristics.$text: This Order must be issued after a Capital Element has been targeted by an enemy attack.

characteristics.name: Effect
characteristics.$text: An Element may increase the number of Attack Dice rolled in a Secondary Weapon Attack by +2.

characteristics.name: Use
characteristics.$text: This Order must be issued prior to any Inital Dice Roll.

characteristics.name: Effect
characteristics.$text: The Element may remove a single Vulnerable Marker allocated to it.

characteristics.name: Use
characteristics.$text: This Order must be executed during the Execute Orders Step of the Order Dice Phase of a Turn.

sharedRules.name: [AS] Assault Specialist
sharedRules.description: Elements with the Assault Specialist Loadout may elect to add or deduct the Value shown in parenthesis from the result on the Boarding Result Table. If both sides involved in a Boarding Action have the Assault Specialist Loadout they cancel each other out irrespective of the Values involved.

sharedRules.name: [CA] Carrier Action
sharedRules.description:
Elements with the Carrier Action (Value) Loadout may re-launch a number of Wings equal to the Value listed in their Loadout's parenthesis during the End Phase. The Wing or Wings are immediately deployed within 8" of their Formation Base.

Wings deployed in this manner must be formed into a legal Wing and they may only be taken from the casualties in the Faction's Scrapyard.
FAQ Example: If a player has a mix of 9 Flight Tokens in their scrapyard and an Element has a Carrier Action (2) Loadout, ALL the Flight Tokens can return to battle but MUST be formed into 1 or 2 legal Wings.

sharedRules.name: [E] Elusive
sharedRules.description: An Element with the Elusive Loadout causes any attack made by an enemy Element against it to suffer a -1 to its Firepower Rating. However, if the attacker is a Bomber Wing on an Attack Run, or if ALL Elements initiating the Firing Solution at the target also have the Elusive Loadout, this modifier is ignored.

sharedRules.name: [EM] Emplacement
sharedRules.description: An Element with this loadout may only form Battle Groups with other Emplacements, may not use the 'Form Up' Fleet Order, and do not require the usual Capital and Non-Capital Elements to Form a Battle Group. In addition, Element Coherency amongst Emplacements within the same Battle Group is 12"

sharedRules.name: [HB] Hard Burn
sharedRules.description: Elements with this Loadout may increase their movement by the value listed in parenthesis, provided the Element DOES NOT execute a Turning Action during its Activation.

sharedRules.name: [HS] Heroic Save
sharedRules.description:
If at any time a Token with the Heroic Save (Type) Loadout should be called upon to be removed as a casualty, roll a single Halo Dice and refer to the Type listed in parenthesis.

>Spartans: on a roll of anything other than a "SKULL", the Spartan Token remains in play and is NOT removed as a casualty.

>Zealots: on a roll of a "1" or "2", the Zealot Token remains in play and is NOT removed as a casualty.

>Troopers: on a roll of a "2", the Trooper Token is NOT removed as a casualty.

sharedRules.name: [L] Labyrinthine
sharedRules.description: Elements with the Labyrinthine Loadout ALWAYS reduce the result rolled on the Boarding Result Table by 2. This is applied after all other loadouts have taken effect.

sharedRules.name: [MB] Missile Barrage*
sharedRules.description: Despite being launched from the Port and Starboard Missile housing of a vessel, these weapons may redirect themselves to target Elements within the Fore Arc with a SINGLE salvo. However, unlike standard Firing Solutions, this salvo of Missiles MUST target the CLOSEST enemy Element in the firing Element's Fore Arc, and Port and Starboard Arcs may not be used during the Activation.

sharedRules.name: [PD] Point Defence
sharedRules.description:
This Loadout represents weapons most commonly used to defend against Bombers and Boarding Craft that are performing Attack Runs or Boarding Assaults against a target Element.

In addition, Point Defence systems can also be used to defend against attacks made by Elements with the Missile Weapons Loadout. In all cases, the value inside the parenthesis is the number of Dice added to an elements Defence Dice Pool Prior to rolling.

sharedRules.name: [TA] Titanium Armour
sharedRules.description: An Element with the Titanium Armour (value) Loadout may add the Value listed in the parenthesis to its Defence Dice Pool when defending against an Attack, provided the Attack is made against the FIRST level of Damage on the Element's Damage Track. Once an Element with Titanium Armour takes a Damage Token, the benefit of Titanium Armour is lost, and the Value can no longer be added to any Defence Dice Pools.

sharedRules.name: Assigned
sharedRules.description: This Heroic Character must be assigned to a specific Formation Base within the Fleet at the start of the battle.

sharedRules.name: MAC
sharedRules.description:
Roll the Attack Dice Pool as normal. Assuming the target Element is required to make a Defensive Pool Roll, BEFORE rolling the Defence Dice Pool, check the combined values of all of the MACs taking part in the Firing Solution by add the value in parenthesis of the MAC loadouts.

>If the combined Values of the MACs is 2-3, roll ONE Halo Dice and on a result of a "SKULL" the Target Element gains a Vunerable Token.

>If the combined Values of the MACs is 4-5, roll ONE Halo Dice and on a result of a "SKULL" or a "2"  the Target Element gains a Vunerable Token.

>If the combined Values of the MACs is 6 or above, roll ONE Halo Dice and on a result of a "2" or a "1" or a "MISS"  the Target Element gains a Vunerable Token.

Remember that this effect takes palce BEFORE any Defence Dice Pool rolls and CANNOT be affected by Loadouts.

sharedRules.name: Missiles
sharedRules.description: Elements with the Missile Loadout gain a +1 on their Firepower Rating when firing at targets at Long Range. In addition, Elements defending against Missile Weapons may add the value in their Point Defence (Value) Loadout when constructing a Defence Dice Pool.

sharedRules.name: [H] High Value Target**
sharedRules.description: This Element is considered to have a build rating of one less than listed for the purpose of fleet building.

sharedRules.name: [OP] Operational Support
sharedRules.description: During the Perform Carrier Actions step in the End Phase, you may place a single new Boarding Craft on the Phoenix's Formation Base. This Formation may never exceed its original boarding craft allocation at any given time.

sharedRules.name: [DA] Defence Array
sharedRules.description: An Element with the Defence Arrays (Value) Loadout may add the Value listed in Parathesis to its Defence Dice Pool when defending against Attack by the enemy or when colliding with Terrain.

sharedRules.name: [AT] Advanced Targeting
sharedRules.description: This Formation may choose to re-roll any INITAL rolls of a SKULL when performing an Attack with its Heavy MAC Cannon. These dice must be rolled seperatly. The attack then moves to the re-roll Step as normal.
